style: Bright, bold Saturday-morning cartoon for kids ages 5-7, about goofy desert racers in a sunny junkyard wasteland. Chunky rounded shapes, thick dark outlines, saturated warm colors (sunny orange, rusty red, turquoise, lime green, golden yellow), flat cel shading with a little grit texture. Vehicles are built from junk: bolts, patches, big tires, exhaust pipes. Characters are silly and friendly with big grins. Nothing scary: no weapons, no blood, no fire hurting anyone, no real brands, no words or letters anywhere.

rules.sprite: Single character or object only, centered, whole thing visible with a little margin. Background must be one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) with no gradient, no shadow, no ground, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or hot pink anywhere on the subject.
rules.backdrop: Full-bleed painting that fills the whole frame, no text, no letters, no border.
rules.texture: Seamless tileable surface texture seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE (flat top-down, orthographic), evenly lit with no strong shadows, no horizon, no objects sticking up, no characters, no text. Fills the whole frame edge to edge.

images.prompt: Epic but friendly title screen for a kids' racing game: four goofy junk-built race cars (a rusty dune buggy, a spiky pickup truck, a giant monster truck, a huge rig with a funny horn) roaring toward the viewer across orange desert dunes, big dust clouds, a giant cartoon sun, mesas and a far-off volcano. Leave the upper-middle third fairly empty sky for a logo.

Inside a cozy cartoon wasteland garage made of corrugated metal and junk: tool walls with giant wrenches, stacked tires, oil cans, hanging string lights, a big open door showing the orange desert. A round empty turntable platform in the center foreground. Warm, inviting, fun.

A treasure-map style overworld of a cartoon wasteland seen from above at an angle: orange sand dunes on the left, a canyon full of junk piles, a bright green goo swamp with giant mushrooms, a volcano with glowing orange lava roads on the right, and a big round stadium dome in the middle. Dirt roads connect them. Parchment-edged, colorful and fun.

A celebration scene in a junkyard stadium: a three-step winners' podium made of crates and tires in the center (empty), confetti, balloons, cheering silly cartoon crowd in the stands, fireworks of stars in a sunset sky.
Dusty Dunes: rolling orange sand dunes, a dirt race track with a ramp, cactus with happy faces, a cow-skull shaped rock that looks friendly, blue sky with puffy clouds.
